page.layout: One column of running text, with marginal notes in the right margin. Right margin: "Genu." beside the first paragraph and "Tibia." beside the Tibia paragraph. Below the text: catchword "ali-" at right, under the signature line.

main_text.p: Genu habet rotulam, quam Patellam vocant, quæ est os mobile, & orbiculare, instar scuti, tegendo femoris & cruris articulo præpositum,Genu.
Patella cum femore articulatur per Ginglymon;
Crurís ossa[?] sunt longa vel brevia.
Longa sunt dimensionis longæ inter femur & talum, ut Tibia & Fibula.
Tibia est crassius & grandius os; altius ad femur ascendens.Tibia.
Superior pars tibiæ latior est & crassior, duos sinus leviter & in superficie fortita, inter quos est tuberculum quod-dam prominens & asperum.
A superiore hac parte deorsum proce-dens sensim attenuatur, longioribus li-neis ac finibus variis distincta, triangularem formam imitatur.
Inferior tibiæ pars rursum crassescit, & in caput definit, quod in superficie amplo sinu excisum tali insertionem exci-pit.
Hujus capitis pars interna in processum

page.notes: The right-margin note "Genu." and "Tibia." are printed in italic, marked as notes. Faint show-through from the reverse side in the margins and centre is ignored. The signature "Z 5" and the word "offa" (read as ossa[?]) are uncertain. The catchword "ali-" is taken as the word that begins the next page. The hyphenated words at line ends keep their printed hyphens.
